needs.title: What a practice website has to do.
needs.description: Patients rarely search for long. They want to know when the practice is open, what it offers and how to get an appointment.

items.title: Opening hours at a glance
items.description: Hours, phone number and holiday notices are where people expect them, with no searching and no detours.

items.title: Readable for everyone
items.description: Large type, clear contrast and plain language help older patients and small screens alike.

items.title: Findable in Münster
items.description: A clean foundation for local search, so search engines can match the practice, its services and its location correctly.

example.title: Hausarztpraxis Weber: a fictional practice as an example.

facts.title: Calm design
facts.description: Muted green on warm white, large typography and clear contrast instead of visual noise.

facts.title: The way to an appointment
facts.description: Booking by phone, opening hours and notes on holidays and availability at a glance.

facts.title: Data-light
facts.description: Built in the concept without cookies, tracking or external services.

disclaimerStatement.title: Information yes, healing promises no.
disclaimerStatement.description: A practice website informs about services and procedures. Healing promises and comparisons are legally sensitive for doctors, so have your legal notice, privacy policy and advertising texts reviewed by a qualified professional. And: nobody can seriously guarantee Google rankings.

faq.title: What you'd want to know beforehand.

items.question: How much does a website for a medical practice cost?
items.answer: It depends on the scope: number of pages, team photos, languages and the features you want. Our packages and prices give you a guide. You receive a concrete quote after a short conversation, with no obligation.

items.question: Do you build websites for practices in Münster and the surrounding area?
items.answer: Yes. We build websites for practices in Münster, the Münsterland region and across Germany. Coordination and delivery work conveniently online.

items.question: Is Hausarztpraxis Weber a real client project?
items.answer: No. Hausarztpraxis Weber is a fictional practice that we built as a concept project to show our work on a health topic. Concept projects are labelled as such in the portfolio.

items.question: Can patients book appointments online?
items.answer: In the concept, appointments are made by phone. Online booking is possible as an extension; we discuss what suits your practice.

items.question: What content do I need to get started?
items.answer: Ideally photos of the practice and team, opening hours, an overview of services and the legally required details. If something is missing, we clarify in a conversation how to proceed.
